content: पिङ्ग {%a.%} [पिञ्ज्-वर्णे अञ्च न्यङ्क्व ˚कुत्वम्] Reddish-brown, tawny, yellow-red; अन्तर्निविष्टामलपिङ्गतारम् (विलोचनम्) <ls>Ku. 7. 33</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 4. 5. 13</ls>; <ls>Mv. 5. 44</ls>. .{@-ङ्गः@} .²1 The tawny colour. .²2 A buffalo. .²3 A rat. .{@-ङ्गा@} .²1 Turmeric. .²2 Saffron. .²3 A kind of yellow pigment. .²4 An epithet of Durgā. .²5 A bow-string. .²6 A tubular vessel of the human body which according to the Yoga system is the channel of respiration and circulation for one side. .{@-ङ्गम्@} A young animal.
